# masterdaweb_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project by its id or its name, with how much it groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "masterdaweb_project" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

resource "masterdaweb_serverless_service" "api" {
  project_id = data.masterdaweb_project.shop.id
  name       = "api"
  kind       = "PRIVATE"
  image      = { ref = "ghcr.io/acme/api:2.0" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The project's id. Give the id or the name.
- `name` (String) The project's name. Give the id or the name.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_count` (Number) How many buckets it has: put in it, or bound to its services.
- `created_at` (String) When the project was created (RFC 3339).
- `database_count` (Number) How many databases it has: made for it, or bound to its services.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Whether the project is protected from deletion.
- `deploys_frozen` (Boolean) Whether new deployments are refused until the freeze is lifted.
- `description` (String) What the project is for.
- `instance_count` (Number) How many instances are in it.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the project is paused (its services stopped).
- `region` (String) Where the project's serverless services run.
- `service_count` (Number) How many serverless services it has.
